new: Each story now carries its own miniatures: its station icon in a shared room and its props on the design room's table come from its own folder.
A new story with miniatures needs no change to the app itself to show its icon and its props.
The example story, Six handshakes, has a miniature of its own: a ring of people with three shortcuts.
An installed app drops old copies of narrations it no longer uses, which frees up to about 60 MB.
test: In a shared room, check every circle shows its story's icon over its ring, as before.
Open the design room and check the table looks as before, with one more plate for Six handshakes.
Put a prop on the stage and check its card, then move a miniature by hand and check the others see it.
On a phone, press Take all stories, then turn the network off and open a story you have not played.
untested: The icons and the design room's table in a real headset: they looked the same as before in pictures.
How long the icons take to appear on a slow network in a headset.
